rk.title: Recovery Key
rk.hint: If the Recovery Key paper is lost or someone else has seen it, make a new key here. From that moment the old key stops working.
rk.why: Without a Recovery Key, if the computer breaks or is stolen, the backups cannot be opened and the owner password cannot be recovered.
rk.dialog.title: Make a new Recovery Key
rk.confirm.lead: This makes a new key. Please read these points:
rk.confirm.paper: The old paper stops working. Throw it away and keep only the new one.
rk.confirm.backups: Backups on this computer and on a USB drive or cloud folder that is connected right now are updated to the new key automatically.
rk.confirm.away: Copies on a drive or folder that is not connected still need the old key. Connect all your drives before you start.
rk.passwordHint: Enter the owner password again to be sure.
rk.new.title: Your new key
rk.result.local: {n} backup(s) on this computer were updated.
rk.result.usb: {n} backup(s) on the USB drive were updated.
rk.result.cloud: {n} backup(s) in the cloud folder were updated.
rk.result.failed: {n} backup(s) could not be updated (for example a read-only drive). They still need the old key.
rk.result.away: Copies on a drive or folder that was not connected still need the old key.
rk.mustConfirm: First confirm that you stored the new key somewhere safe.
audit.act.backup.regenerate_key_failed: Wrong password while changing the Recovery Key
